comments.body_html: Hello, I was curious what the deal with the Secure Containers? comments.author: DanW
comments.body_html:
That’s by design. By default, you can only put uninspected keys in them during raids, and out of raid you can put any keys and any containers (i.e docs cases) in them. It’s one of the fundamental parts of the hardcore ruleset so that pretty much everything you have is at risk.

If you don’t want that restriction, simply change secureContainer.only_use_whitelists_in_this_mod to false in config.json.

comments.author: DanW
comments.body_html:
If you want to add something to the whitelist, first you’ll need to find its ID using a tool like https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search/. In this case, you can search for “ammo” and find that its ID is 5485a8684bdc2da71d8b4567. Then, you’ll want to add that ID to the traders.whitelist_items section of config.json. If the ID is for a specific item, add it to the items section. If it’s the parent of multiple items (which is the case here), add it to the parents section. Then, save the file and restart the server.

For parent ID’s, it might take a little trial-and-error to figure out the right ID’s to use.
